Class SysMLPort.UDPTransmitter

java.lang.Object
sysmlinjava.ports.SysMLPort.UDPTransmitter
Enclosing class:
SysMLPort
public class SysMLPort.UDPTransmitter extends Object
Generic class to transmit SysMLSignals via the User Datagram Protocol (UDP) to a UDPReceiver of an other SysMLPort in another process. UDPTransmitter transmits individual instances of the SysMLSignal to the remote SysMLPort's UDPReceiver via simple datagrams.

  • Method Details

    • transmit

      public void transmit(SysMLSignal signal, InetAddress ipAddress, int udpPort)
      Operation to actually perform the transmission of the specified SysMLSignal. Transmit simply creates the necessary output streams, uses them to construct the datagram with the signal, and sends the datagram via the socket.
      Parameters:
      signal - SysMLSignal to be transmitted to remote (not in this process) port
      ipAddress - IP address of the remote port
      udpPort - udpPort of the remote port

    • stop

      public void stop()
      Stops the transmitter (closes the socket)
